scientific_limitations: Only finite unweighted undirected complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts; unnormalized combinatorial Laplacian; no result for arbitrary or normalized graphs.
No claim that every distinct part size must appear as a global row-norm maximizer.
Numerical checking supplies finite evidence, not an all-dimensional proof or historical-priority guarantee.
title: Complete multipartite heat flow: a sharp endpoint envelope and an ordered hub-to-bulk transition
